paras: Upgrade your BMW braking performance with Paragon Titanium Brake Shims , engineered to reduce heat transfer from the brake pads to the caliper for improved reliability, fade resistance and track durability. Developed for aggressive street and motorsport applications, these titanium shims provide superior thermal insulation compared to standard stainless or OEM backing plates.

By lowering fluid temperatures and protecting seals, Paragon shims help maintain consistent pedal feel during repeated hard braking, making them an ideal upgrade for spirited driving, track days, hill climb and time-attack use.
hl: Dramatically reduces heat transfer to calipers and brake fluid
Minimises brake fade under repeated heavy braking
Protects seals and extends component service life
CNC-cut for precision fitment and pad stability
Reusable and compatible with OEM and performance pads
